definitions.evaluated_items: Number of target strings evaluated in this dataset.
definitions.found_items: How many targets appeared anywhere in ranked guesses (exact matches + candidate list).
definitions.recall_at_1: Fraction of targets with best_rank <= 1. Higher is better.
definitions.recall_at_5: Fraction of targets with best_rank <= 5. Higher is better.
definitions.recall_at_20: Fraction of targets with best_rank <= 20. Higher is better.
definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank across all targets: avg(1/rank), with 0 for not-found.
definitions.mean_rank_found: Average rank among found targets only. Lower is better.
definitions.best_feasible_k: Smallest K where recall@K reaches 1.0 for the evaluated targets. Null means not all targets were found.
definitions.best_rank: Per-target best observed rank (1 is top candidate). Null means the target was not found.
definitions.visual_rows_total: Total redaction rows in guesses for the dataset.
definitions.visual_rows_with_top_guess: Rows where a scored top candidate exists (candidate list non-empty).
definitions.visual_rows_scored: Rows with computed visual score (visual_mean_abs_diff present).
definitions.visual_mean_abs_diff: Mean absolute grayscale delta in the non-redaction overlay window; lower is better.
definitions.visual_median_abs_diff: Median of visual_mean_abs_diff across scored rows; lower is better.
definitions.visual_p90_abs_diff: 90th percentile of visual_mean_abs_diff across scored rows; lower is better.
definitions.visual_mean_changed_pixel_ratio: Average fraction of significantly changed pixels in scored rows; lower is better.
definitions.visual_mean_compared_pixels: Average non-background pixel count used per scored row.
definitions.visual_rerank_rows_considered: Rows eligible for visual rerank candidate scoring (top-K evaluation path).
definitions.visual_rerank_rows_scored: Rows where visual rerank actually scored candidate alternatives.
definitions.visual_rerank_top1_changed: Rows where rerank changed top-1 guess from geometric ranking.
definitions.visual_rerank_top1_changed_ratio: top1_changed / rows_scored for visual rerank; higher means more rerank impact.
definitions.visual_rerank_mean_gain: Average blended-score gain of chosen rerank candidate over baseline top candidate.
definitions.timing_redactions_ms: Average redaction stage runtime in milliseconds.
definitions.timing_fonts_ms: Average font extraction stage runtime in milliseconds.
definitions.timing_guess_ms: Average guessing stage runtime in milliseconds.
definitions.timing_visualize_ms: Average visualization stage runtime in milliseconds.
definitions.timing_orchestrator_total_ms: Average total orchestrator runtime in milliseconds.
definitions.candidate_rows_total: Total redaction rows considered for candidate-count statistics.
definitions.candidate_rows_with_candidates: Rows where the candidate list is non-empty.
definitions.candidate_mean_count: Mean number of candidates per row.
definitions.candidate_median_count: Median number of candidates per row.
definitions.candidate_multi_span_rows: Rows classified as multi-span by anchor-gap ratio.
definitions.candidate_multi_span_mean_count: Mean candidate count for multi-span rows.
definitions.candidate_multi_span_p90_count: 90th percentile candidate count for multi-span rows.
definitions.candidate_single_span_mean_count: Mean candidate count for non-multi-span rows.
definitions.quality_rows_total: Total rows in the guess report for anchor/width quality accounting.
definitions.quality_anchored_rows: Rows that have an anchor pair or one-sided recovered anchor.
definitions.quality_anchor_two_sided_rows: Rows where anchor_mode is two_sided (full left/right anchor).
definitions.quality_anchor_one_sided_rows: Rows where anchor_mode is left_only or right_only.
definitions.quality_width_asset_rows: Rows whose primary candidate width source is embedded font asset shaping.
definitions.quality_width_table_rows: Rows whose primary candidate width source is PDF width table lookup.
definitions.quality_width_core_rows: Rows whose primary candidate width source is core-font width table fallback.
definitions.quality_width_fallback_rows: Rows whose primary candidate width source is heuristic fallback.
definitions.quality_exact_zero_error_rows: Rows where every exact_match exists in candidates with zero raw error.
definitions.quality_exact_invalid_rows: Rows where exact_matches contains any entry missing from candidates or with non-zero raw error.
definitions.consistency_repeats: Number of repeated benchmark runs with the same code/config.
definitions.consistency_all_hashes_identical: True when every repeated run produced the same benchmark hash.
definitions.consistency_hash_match_ratio: Fraction of runs whose hash matches run #1.
definitions.consistency_top1_agreement_ratio: Fraction of rows whose top1 guess is identical across repeated runs.
definitions.consistency_top5_jaccard_mean: Mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of top5 guess sets across repeated runs.
definitions.consistency_mean_rank_stddev: Average per-target standard deviation of rank across repeats.
definitions.consistency_unstable_rows_count: Number of rows that changed top1 guess across repeated runs.
definitions.consistency_unstable_rows_ratio: Unstable row count divided by total compared rows.
